decision.reason: evidence sufficient (proxy gate verdict; the open aspects need proposals): [ev-dc7503345583] states the change concretely. The subject is container image signature verification. The change is a newly added verification type, `SigstoreBundle`, which supports the sigstore bundle format and GitHub Artifact Attestations such as SLSA Provenance. The announcement mentions no removal or change to existing behaviour, so this is an opt-in addition: only environments whose policies choose `SigstoreBundle` are affected, and an operator who does nothing sees no impact. The excerpt cuts off the example policy and so does not show the exact field path, and ev-ea3f83a6e087 and ev-bcf9822c2eb4 are unrelated Service appProtocol diffs. That is why confidence is low.
